args: Inspect RDKit bookmark container semantics and mutation patterns. The reported ASan issue is a heap-use-after-free: RWMol::replaceAtom() installs a copied replacement Atom in the graph and deletes the original but leaves d_atomBookmarks entries pointing to the original. V2000 atom-number bookmarks later resolve through an SGroup SPA and call getIdx() on freed memory. The desired root fix is to preserve bookmark identity by replacing every old pointer in all bookmark vectors with the newly installed atom before deletion, including multiple marks and repeated references. I am currently inspecting rdkit/Code/GraphMol/RWMol.cpp, rdkit/Code/GraphMol/ROMol.h, and rdkit/Code/GraphMol/ROMol.cpp and want confirmation of container/API conventions and analogous code.
